newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice closes higher on bull spreading, cash.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice closes higher on bull spreading, cash.

text.p: Bull spreading and a firm undertone in the cash market boosted CBOT rice futures to a firm close, traders said.
"Bull spreading in the market in the January/September was between nine and 18 cents," a trader said.
Traders said the cash market at the farm level would need to rise to $10.10 to $10.20 per cwt to bring cash rice into the pipeline.
Resistance in the November is at $10.08, $10.21 and $10.29 per cwt, the traders said.
Rice closed five to 10 cents per cwt higher, with November up five at $10.17.
Rice futures volume was estimated at 500 contracts, down from 575 Friday.
